selectionRules: Near: interaction<distance<=R; Far: distance>=2R; stable identity tie-break. Sampled pivot paths are diagnostic, not command validation.

steps: Agent1 Far Resource after first valid inventory close
Agent1 Far Enemy after first combat terminal
Both agents Far Extraction before inventory
Each agent reissue same exit once in Near band outside interaction
Observe real terminal and initial carried settlement
Search A then B while moving
Retaliation then replacement target when naturally triggered
Bounded repeat then stop directives; autonomous terminal
After real completion and new valid task, reject completed cluster

coverageGapPolicy: No Near Extraction at spawn. Use MC01-X normal movement then reissue in Near band; no Warp. Multi-member exit fallback uses constructed scene because each actual cluster has one point. First-approach and LostSight require dedicated boundary cases because scene R=200.
